content.description:
Who We Are & Why Join Us

Avathon is the leading Industrial AI autonomy platform, helping customers across heavy industries -- energy, mining, manufacturing, aerospace, defense, and logistics -- accelerate the journey toward autonomous operations. Our platform is built on a Computational Knowledge Graph foundation that contextualizes and connects operational data across siloed systems, bringing together time series, structured, unstructured, and machine vision data to power AI-driven applications in asset performance management, supply chain intelligence, visual AI, and global trade management. With capabilities spanning digital twins, normal behavior modeling, natural language processing, and computer vision, Avathon delivers real-time predictive intelligence and agentic decision-making at industrial scale.

Cutting-Edge AI Innovation -- Join a team at the forefront of AI, developing groundbreaking solutions that shape the future. High-Growth Environment -- Thrive in a fast-scaling startup where agility, collaboration, and rapid professional growth are the norm. Meaningful Impact -- Work on AI-driven projects that drive real change across industries and improve lives.

Learn more at: avathon.com

The role

Title: Senior Director, Brand and Communications

Reports to: SVP of Marketing

Location: SF Bay Area

The Senior Director, Brand and Communications is a doer and strategist. You will build Avathon’s corporate reputation, distinct brand, and executive visibility through strategic storytelling, media engagement, creative leadership, and events. You are a member of the marketing leadership team responsible for turning a category-defining platform into durable, efficient ARR growth.

What you'll work on

Own corporate brand strategy, narrative, voice, and reputation in partnership with the SVP.

Lead the Brand & Creative Lead and establish creative governance and production priorities.

Develop PR, media relations, announcements, executive communications, and issues management.

Create executive thought-leadership platforms relevant to industrial AI and the physical economy.

Lead corporate conferences, executive forums, and strategic event execution; partner with ABM on account-specific objectives.

Manage external communications, events, and creative partners as needed.

Manage budgeting, measurement and reporting on brand and communications.

Coordinate with Product Marketing on technical claims, analyst-related announcements, and customer advocacy.

What we’re looking for

10-12+ years in corporate communications, brand, and events in technology marketing.

Experience transforming an engineering led organization into a category leader.

Strategic thinker who can orchestrate integrated campaigns.

Strong corporate storytelling, executive communications, PR, and agency management skills.

Experience managing creative talent and strategic events across markets.

Sound editorial and reputation judgment, including sensitive communications.

Comfort with AI-assisted research, monitoring, and production.

Ability to translate events/experiential into measurable sales outcomes

Demonstrated ability to use AI for research, monitoring, drafting, and creative operations, with human approval for reputationally sensitive outputs.

Compensation & Benefits

California base salary range: of $190,000 - $240,000 (based on experience)

Equity in the form of stock options

Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage

401(k) participation

Generous PTO and company holidays

Ongoing learning and development opportunities

Avathon is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, pregnancy, genetic information, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected category under applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Avathon is committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process. If you need a reasonable accommodation, please contact us to discuss how we can assist you.
